name: 1970-batchdecode-dsv2fp8-tp8
model: neuralmagic/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8, not substituted. Ungated, ~237 GB, and not in the local HF cache, so it downloads once before the first run; the id redirects to RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8 and is kept in this spelling.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8, one tensor-parallel group over the eight cards of one node. No pipeline parallelism; a 236B checkpoint does not fit on fewer cards.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 236B parameters in FP8 (static activation scheme), 60 layers, MLA attention, 160 routed + 2 shared experts top-6; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=768, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 6000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 1024 prompt tokens and 512 generated tokens, both fixed (stdev 0), seed 42. `ignore_eos` and `temperature: 0` are set through `backend.extras.body`, so every request generates exactly 512 tokens; note that `backend.sampling_params` is rejected outright by guidellm's openai_http backend.
purpose: A 236-billion-parameter coding assistant generating long completions for 768 concurrent developers on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments for this setup.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then runs
# without whatever this file declares.

# ~237 GB on disk, ungated, and not in the local HF cache -- it downloads once before the first run.
model-path: neuralmagic/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct-FP8

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

# Eight H100s of one node as a single tensor-parallel group. A 236B checkpoint does not fit on fewer.
tp-size: 8

# Every prompt is an independent synthetic draw of the same length, so there is nothing to reuse.
disable-radix-cache: true

# Exactly what the engine derives for itself at tp-size >= 8, so it changes no behaviour. Written
# down so the budget cannot move if the derivation ever does.
mem-fraction-static: 0.83

# The longest request this workload can draw is 1024 + 512 = 1536, so this truncates nothing.
context-length: 4096

random-seed: 42
